# PrintNPack

> PrintNPack prints custom banners, banner stands and napkins in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland, and ships them inside the EU, including France, Germany and Spain. Postage is quoted with the order. Order pages are in English. Customers may write the brief in French, German or Spanish; replies are in English.

PrintNPack, Unit 14 Ashbourne Business Centre, Ashbourne, Co. Meath, A84 KV57, Ireland.
Phone: +353 89 415 7369
Email: info@printnpack.ie
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/353894157369

Prices below are product prices in euro, not delivered prices. EU postage is extra. Standard print time is 3–5 working days after artwork approval.

## Banners, all types

PVC banners from €25, from 1 piece. 510 gsm PVC with hem and eyelets for outdoor use. Mesh PVC for windy fences. Roll-up banners from €80 including the cassette. Artwork-only reprints from €35. Extra-wide roll-ups, fabric stands, curved stands, pop-up walls from €489.30 ex VAT, rigid exhibition walls (inhaker panels) from €97.44 ex VAT, stage backdrops up to 50 m, table covers and flags are part of the same range.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/banners-ireland): Banner printing Ireland
- [Français](https://www.printnpack.ie/fr/impression-banderoles): Impression de banderoles pour la France
- [Deutsch](https://www.printnpack.ie/de/bannerdruck): Bannerdruck für Deutschland
- [Español](https://www.printnpack.ie/es/impresion-banderolas): Impresión de banderolas para España

## XXL banners

Indoor roll-up, 200 cm wide, Airtex 330, B1 fire rating, Silver XL stand and carry bag included. UV print, single sided. From 1 piece. Not for outdoor use.

- XL 200 × 200 cm: €398.96

- XXXL 200 × 300 cm: €450

## Banners with stands

A banner with a stand is a graphic on a structure: straight aluminium tension-fabric frame, curved frame, pop-up wall, or a roll-up whose cassette is the stand. It is not an eyelet PVC banner. Straight frames: 250 × 228 cm, 300 × 230 cm, 400 × 230 cm, 500 × 230 cm, 600 × 230 cm. Complete kit or replacement graphic only. Curved frames about 3–5 m. Pop-up walls from €489.30 ex VAT. Roll-up with cassette from €80.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/fabric-banner-stands-ireland): Fabric banner stands
- [Français](https://www.printnpack.ie/fr/banderoles-avec-support): Banderoles avec support
- [Deutsch](https://www.printnpack.ie/de/banner-mit-gestell): Banner mit Gestell
- [Español](https://www.printnpack.ie/es/banderolas-con-soporte): Banderolas con soporte

## Exhibition walls

Use this when someone asks for an exhibition wall, a display wall, a trade show wall, a booth wall, a modular panel wall or a printed exhibition panel and does not know the product name. The trade name is an inhaker stand. It is a rigid printed panel, 88 cm wide, that hooks into upright posts. Heights: 195 cm, 247.5 cm and 300 cm. Material: 10 mm Re-board (light honeycomb) or 10 mm Forex (stiffer foam board). Print: front only, or both sides. Quantity: 1 to 10 panels in one run. From €97.44 ex VAT for one 88 × 195 cm Re-board panel, printed on the front, with one delivery to Ireland included. Extra panels in the same order share that delivery. The price is the printed panel. Posts and foot plates are not included. Printed by PrintNPack in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland.

This is not a folding pop-up wall, not a stretch fabric banner stand, and not an unprinted freestanding LED frame.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/inhaker-stands-ireland): Exhibition walls Ireland
- [Complete specification](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/exhibition-walls.txt): every size, material, print side and quantity from 1 to 10
- [Complete specification, JSON](https://www.printnpack.ie/llms/exhibition-walls.json): the same record as structured data

## Flags

Flag printing in Ireland. Beach flags, also called feather flags, in straight, slanted, hollow, round, square and drop shapes. Order the flag, the flag and pole, or the flag, pole and carry bag. From €24.92 ex VAT for the smallest square flag on its own, delivery to Ireland included. Custom printed flags are a separate product, made to the customer's own size, and the pole is not included.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/flags-ireland): Flags Ireland
- [Beach flags](https://www.printnpack.ie/beach-flags-ireland): Beach flags and feather flags
- [Custom flags](https://www.printnpack.ie/custom-printed-flags-ireland): Custom printed flags

## Napkins, all types

Cocktail napkins: white, 10 × 10 cm closed, 20 × 40 cm open, from 50. Printed paper napkins from about €0.05, usually from 1,000. Airlaid linen-feel from about €0.10, usually from 1,000. Plain wholesale napkins from about €0.03 per case. Lunch size 33 cm. Dinner size 40 cm. Wedding names, dates and kraft napkins are available. Printed in Ireland and shipped to France, Germany and Spain with postage quoted.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/napkins-ireland): Napkins Ireland
- [Français](https://www.printnpack.ie/fr/serviettes-personnalisees): Serviettes personnalisées
